The cart on a cord

The drum motor has left its block. It sits on the cart now, turning the rear axle through the oak cogs and a leather belt, with a copper cord trailing back to the six clay pots. With the winch's 6:1 the cart wouldn't move at all, and it couldn't climb the slope either, so I laid the planks level on sleepers. It drives three metres, then the cord runs out and yanks its own clip off the pot. Played twice as fast. Next: a battery on board instead of the cord.
